field_principles.arc_gap_audit_complete_score: A complete audit may establish no missing tool.
field_principles.banked_credit_rows: Persistent progress must be separated from transient level readings.
field_principles.causal_claims: Explicit false claim fields prevent one unpaired session from becoming efficacy evidence.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed work; never pad time to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_host: The actual hostname, kept out of execution_venue's closed set.
field_principles.execution_venue: Closed-set class (host/kv260/gatemate/polarfire) limits the scope of the evidence.
field_principles.experiment_id: The task identifier binds this result to REQ-ARC-WMTE-7194.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo each declared reason beside the actual evidence contract.
field_principles.gap_rows: Each candidate needs a real call, failure and source receipt.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.generalization_recommendation: A bounded recommendation is either counterexample-backed or an honest no-gap count.
field_principles.historical_context: Historical calls remain context and never increase the new-session denominator.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings, including nulls; blocked_* for external blocks. Never promote infrastructure readiness as scientific benefit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the planned workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Apply the duration floor for the work actually performed.
field_principles.model_invoked: False; upstream inference is cited, not repeated.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record each required resource and its actual observed state.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze all stochastic choices before reading held-out outcomes.
field_principles.raw_manifest_receipts: Manifest receipts show which cached session bytes supplied each join.
field_principles.refinement_mutation_counts: Zero durable mutations keep recommendations separate from policy changes.
field_principles.refinement_tool_runs: Private-ledger command receipts prove both shipped refinement tools ran.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash inputs, code, seeds and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Retain unit ID, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for every comparison.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned and completed counts, independent units and exclusions.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets later reducers reject incompatible evidence.
field_principles.session_cost_rows: Recompute the single measured session; make no paired efficacy claim.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, inputs and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when verification uses the same correctness authority; separate implementations alone do not remove circularity.
